side-by-side-pdf-comparison.title: Side‑by‑Side PDF Comparison with Change Marks
side-by-side-pdf-comparison.description: Loads two PDF files, enables additional change marks, performs a side‑by‑side visual comparison, and saves the resulting comparison PDF.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison-no-additiona.title: Side‑by‑Side PDF Comparison without Additional Change Marks
side-by-side-pdf-comparison-no-additiona.description: Loads two PDF files, disables the visual markers for additional changes, compares the documents side‑by‑side, and saves the result as a new PDF.

compare-pdfs-ignore-spaces.title: Compare PDFs Ignoring Spaces with Side‑by‑Side Comparison
compare-pdfs-ignore-spaces.description: Demonstrates creating two PDFs, setting ComparisonMode to IgnoreSpaces, performing a side‑by‑side comparison, and saving the resulting PDF.

side-by-side-pdf-page-comparison.title: Side‑by‑Side PDF Page Comparison
side-by-side-pdf-page-comparison.description: Loads two PDF files, compares their first pages side‑by‑side using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API, and saves the resulting comparison PDF.

generate-red-highlight-png-diff-first-pa.title: Generate Red-Highlight PNG Diff of First Pages of Two PDFs
generate-red-highlight-png-diff-first-pa.description: Loads two PDF files, compares their first pages using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer, and saves a PNG image highlighting differences in red.

visual-pdf-diff-to-png.title: Create Visual PDF Diff and Export Pages as PNG
visual-pdf-diff-to-png.description: The example loads two PDF files, uses Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer with a 0.1 threshold to generate a diff PDF, and then renders each diff page to separate PNG images.

pdf-visual-diff-blue-png.title: Create a Blue‑Highlighted PDF Visual Diff and Save as PNG
pdf-visual-diff-blue-png.description: Loads two PDF files, uses Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer to highlight differences in blue, renders the first page diff to a PNG image, and saves it to disk.

pdf-diff-300dpi-png.title: Generate PNG Diff Images for PDFs at 300 DPI
pdf-diff-300dpi-png.description: Loads two PDF files, configures a GraphicalPdfComparer with a 300 DPI resolution, and creates per‑page PNG images that highlight visual differences.

generate-pdf-comparison-report.title: Generate PDF Comparison Report with Aspose.Pdf
generate-pdf-comparison-report.description: Loads two PDF files, compares them using GraphicalPdfComparer, and saves a visual comparison report as a PDF.

generate-visual-difference-image-between.title: Generate Visual Difference Image Between Two PDFs
generate-visual-difference-image-between.description: Shows how to compare the first pages of two PDF documents with Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer, create a pixel‑level difference image, and save it as a PNG file.

render-pdf-page-to-png.title: Render PDF Page to PNG Image
render-pdf-page-to-png.description: Loads a PDF document, renders a specified page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.Devices, and saves the image file.

compare-pdfs-page-by-page-json-diff.title: Compare Two PDFs Page‑by‑Page and Generate JSON Diff
compare-pdfs-page-by-page-json-diff.description: Loads two PDF files, performs a text‑based page‑by‑page comparison using Aspose.Pdf, and writes the differences to a JSON report file.

compare-pdfs-markdown-diff.title: Compare Two PDFs and Generate a Markdown Diff
compare-pdfs-markdown-diff.description: Loads two PDF files, performs a flat‑text comparison using Aspose.Pdf's TextPdfComparer, and writes the differences to a Markdown file.

compare-pdfs-excluding-tables-json-diff.title: Compare PDFs Excluding Tables and Save Diff as JSON
compare-pdfs-excluding-tables-json-diff.description: Shows how to load two PDF documents, set ComparisonOptions to exclude tables, run a page‑by‑page text comparison, and write the differences to a JSON file.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison-excluded-are.title: Side-by-side PDF Comparison with Excluded Areas
side-by-side-pdf-comparison-excluded-are.description: Demonstrates loading two PDFs, defining exclusion rectangles, and generating a side‑by‑side comparison PDF using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison-exclude-area.title: Side-by-side PDF Comparison with Excluded Areas
side-by-side-pdf-comparison-exclude-area.description: Shows how to load two PDFs, define exclusion rectangles for the second document, run a side‑by‑side text comparison, and save the comparison result as a new PDF.

compare-pdfs-text-extraction-area-markdo.title: Compare PDFs Text Within a Specified Area and Generate Markdown Diff
compare-pdfs-text-extraction-area-markdo.description: The example loads two PDF files, defines a rectangular extraction area for text comparison, compares the documents page by page, and saves the differences as a Markdown file.

compare-pdfs-insert-first-html-report.title: Compare PDFs with Insert-First Priority and Generate HTML Report
compare-pdfs-insert-first-html-report.description: Loads two PDF files, sets the comparison to prioritize insert operations, performs a page‑by‑page text comparison, and creates an HTML diff report.

pdf-flat-text-comparison-delete-first-ma.title: Flat‑Text PDF Comparison with Delete‑First Priority and Markdown Output
pdf-flat-text-comparison-delete-first-ma.description: The example loads two PDF files, configures the comparison to prioritize delete operations, performs a flat‑text page‑by‑page comparison, and writes the differences to a Markdown file.

compare-pdfs-export-diff-statistics-json.title: Compare Two PDFs and Export Difference Statistics as JSON
compare-pdfs-export-diff-statistics-json.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF files, perform side‑by‑side visual comparison and text‑based comparison, and save the resulting diff PDF and a JSON file containing comparison statistics.

compare-pdf-pages-save-difference-png.title: Compare PDF Pages and Save Difference as PNG
compare-pdf-pages-save-difference-png.description: Loads two PDF files, compares selected pages using Aspose.Pdf's graphical comparer, and saves the visual difference as a PNG image.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison__v2.title: Side-by-Side PDF Comparison
side-by-side-pdf-comparison__v2.description: Loads two PDF files, compares them page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf's SideBySidePdfComparer, and saves a combined PDF that highlights the differences.

compare-two-pdfs-side-by-side.title: Compare Two PDFs Side‑by‑Side and Save Result
compare-two-pdfs-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF files, performing a side‑by‑side comparison using Aspose.Pdf's default options, and saving the comparison result as a new PDF document.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison-additional-c.title: Side-by-Side PDF Comparison with Additional Change Marks
side-by-side-pdf-comparison-additional-c.description: Shows how to load two PDFs, enable additional change marks in side‑by‑side comparison options, and generate a comparison PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

side-by-side-pdf-comparison-no-additiona.title: Side‑by‑Side PDF Comparison without Additional Change Marks
side-by-side-pdf-comparison-no-additiona.description: The example loads two PDF files, disables additional change marks, performs a side‑by‑side comparison of the entire documents using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison, and saves the resulting comparison PDF.

compare-pdfs-side-by-side-ignore-spaces.title: Compare Two PDFs Side-by-Side Ignoring Spaces
compare-pdfs-side-by-side-ignore-spaces.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF documents, configuring side‑by‑side comparison options to show change marks and ignore spaces, and saving the resulting comparison PDF.

compare-pdf-pages-to-png-diff.title: Compare PDF Pages and Generate PNG Diff with Custom Threshold and Color
compare-pdf-pages-to-png-diff.description: Loads two PDF files, sets a 5% pixel change threshold and a custom red highlight color, then compares the first pages and saves the visual differences as a PNG image.

generate-png-diff-between-two-pdfs.title: Generate PNG Diff Image Between Two PDFs
generate-png-diff-between-two-pdfs.description: Loads two PDF files, configures a GraphicalPdfComparer to highlight differences in green, and creates a PNG image showing the visual diff of the first pages.

generate-png-diff-between-two-pdfs__v2.title: Generate PNG Diff Image Between Two PDFs at 150 DPI
generate-png-diff-between-two-pdfs__v2.description: Loads two PDF files, configures GraphicalPdfComparer to 150 DPI, creates a pixel-difference image of the first pages, and saves it as a PNG.

compare-pdf-text-to-markdown-excluding-t.title: Compare PDF Text and Export Markdown Diff (Exclude Tables)
compare-pdf-text-to-markdown-excluding-t.description: Loads two PDF files, performs a flat text comparison while ignoring tables, and writes the differences to a Markdown file.

compare-pdfs-page-by-page-exclude-areas-.title: Compare PDFs Page‑by‑Page with Excluded Areas and Save JSON Diff
compare-pdfs-page-by-page-exclude-areas-.description: Loads two PDF files, defines exclusion rectangles for the first document, compares them page by page using text comparison, and writes the differences to a JSON file.

compare-pdfs-page-by-page-html-diff.title: Compare PDFs Page‑by‑Page and Generate HTML Diff
compare-pdfs-page-by-page-html-diff.description: Loads two PDF documents, compares their text content page by page within a specified extraction area, and outputs the differences as an HTML report.
